title: Pure Trickstar
summary: Pure Trickstar burn, Link, and Fusion build, leveraging LIGHT Fairy idols that chip away at the opponent's Life Points with relentless 200-point burn triggers on virtually every card action. The addition of modern Fusion support provides extra combo extension and board control alongside the classic Lycoris bounce loops.

summary.title: Starters
points: Trickstar Candina searches any Trickstar card from your Deck upon Normal Summon and burns the opponent for 200 damage each time they activate a Spell or Trap.

Trickstar Light Stage searches any Trickstar monster on activation, freezes a Set card in the opponent's Spell & Trap Zone until the End Phase, and adds 200 bonus burn whenever a Trickstar inflicts damage.
Trickstar Hoody Special Summons itself from the hand if you control a Trickstar Fusion or Link Monster, and searches Trickstar Fusion or Trickstar Diffusion when used as Link Material.
Trickstar Lilybell Special Summons itself from hand whenever added to your hand other than by drawing, attacks directly, and adds a Trickstar monster from GY back to hand on battle damage.
Trickstar Corobane Special Summons itself from hand when you control no monsters or only Trickstar monsters, and doubles a Trickstar's ATK during damage calculation from hand.

summary.title: Opening: Candina + Light Stage
steps: Activate Trickstar Light Stage to search Trickstar Candina from your Deck.
Normal Summon Trickstar Candina to search Trickstar Festival (or Trickstar Lycoris).
Activate Trickstar Festival to summon two Trickstar Tokens.
Link Summon Trickstar Bloom or Trickstar Noble Angel using the tokens and Candina.
Bounce Candina to the hand with Trickstar Lycoris as a Quick Effect, setting up recurring burn on enemy draws and searches.

summary.title: Bosses & Burn Engine
points: Trickstar Lycoris reveals itself in hand as a Quick Effect to bounce a face-up Trickstar you control to hand and Special Summon itself, inflicting 200 damage whenever a card is added to the opponent's hand.
Trickstar Band Drumatis searches a Trickstar card upon Fusion Summon and reduces an opponent monster's ATK to 0 whenever Trickstar effect damage is dealt.
Trickstar Noble Angel revives a Trickstar monster from GY and targets and destroys an opponent's card each time effect damage is inflicted.
Trickstar Holly Angel protects linked Trickstars from destruction and burns 200 damage whenever a Trickstar is Normal or Special Summoned to a zone it points to.
Trickstar Bella Madonna is completely immune to other card effects while pointing to no monsters and burns the opponent for 500 damage per Trickstar with a different name in your GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Trickstar Reincarnation banishes the opponent's entire hand and forces them to draw the same number of cards, triggering massive burn damage when chained with multiple Trickstar Lycoris, and banishes itself from GY to revive a Trickstar.
Trickstar Fusion Fusion Summons a Trickstar Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck and recycles a banished or GY Trickstar monster back to hand.
Trickstar Diffusion functions as a versatile Trap that either Fusion Summons from the GY by banishing materials or immediately performs a Link Summon during the opponent's turn.
Trickstar Festival generates two Trickstar Tokens and banishes itself from the GY to protect Extra Deck Trickstar monsters from destruction.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Blue Tears cards (such as Tearlaments/Blue Tears Trap support) are omitted because the deck functions as a self-contained pure Trickstar engine, relying strictly on in-archetype searchers and burn loops.
